cohort: Participants were 9 early-on survivors of acute lymphoblastic leukemia (mean age 10.93 years) who were within 6 months to 5 years of treatment completion and able to participate in a telehealth exercise intervention.
finding: The home-based telehealth exercise intervention demonstrated high adherence and participation rates, suggesting feasibility, and showed promising benefits for functional performance and bone health in early-on survivors of acute lymphoblastic leukemia.
